name: Emergency Air Support
scope: Complete reads of eight listed behaviour functions; first75 config lines only. Remaining client/audio/init functions and remaining config not reviewed. Not whole-mod parity.
findings: Request entry authenticates invoking multiplayer owner against the player caller and requires living group leader. This is a useful authority pattern, not evidence that all subsequent writers handle locality changes.

Aircraft discovery is a fixed side-based vanilla pool, excluding SOG and most independent factions. It does not generally match the caller faction despite the overview. Do not adopt a silent vanilla fallback for mission-selected factions.
Target discovery scans allUnits twice and checks every friendly against candidate hostiles. It has no native knowledge gate; observed target selection is omniscient and work scales with population.

Immediate threat priority considers all living caller-group members within150m; modest static/ground vehicle bias precedes distance ordering. Outside that area selection is random. Useful supported-element protection intent, not permission to read hidden enemy poses.

Response stages jets until globally counted enemy strength reaches20percent, then gunships until10percent. Up to two primary and one secondary helicopter slots are replenished; no overall response deadline. Hidden population counts cannot be CBE completion evidence.

Helicopters receive ammunition fill, absolute skill0.85 and reveal target4; subsequent four-second retargeting reveals fresh exact target positions. These shortcuts conflict with mission skill authority, knowledge uncertainty and existing-stock support.
Fixed-wing delivery delegates BIS moduleCAS and observes only its script handle. That does not prove quiescence of every native/module writer for handover to a persistent CBE aircraft.

Unarmed FAC uses native LOITER with captive/CARELESS protection. It does not contribute observed knowledge to findTargets. Its support value is not implemented reconnaissance simply because an observer aircraft exists.

Aircraft departure waits have no hard deadline; spawned crews and aircraft are deleted after departure or damage delay without an intervening authority check for curator takeover. No such cleanup may be copied onto mission-owned assets.

retainIntent: Protect the supported element using threats near every participating actor, with bounded known-contact scoring.
Separate observation, attack and departure roles; use capability-appropriate existing aircraft and real finite task results.
redesign: Stage support from known threats and mission fire policy, not total hidden enemy counts.
Use existing owner-local air attack FSM and flight leases; observation must publish actual knowledge, not a decorative invulnerable FAC.
Any future spawn task must be explicit, faction/capability validated, finite and relinquish deletion rights after external takeover.
reject: Global omniscient target scans and reveal4.
Automatic ammunition and absolute skill resets.
Random ordnance/loadout substitution and unconditional spawned-asset deletion.

currentCbeComparison: aircraft/functions/cortexAirAttackPlan.sqf already selects live loaded weapon/turret pairs, native reported contact positions and bounded terrain routes; do not replace with spawn+SAD.
aircraft/functions/airAttackOperationStep.sqf retains current owner/generation/FSM identity and flight lease before the existing executor; support must compose with that lifecycle.
support/functions/supportRequestStart.sqf is an infantry cross-squad request, not proof of an aircraft observer/strike coordinator. No air-support completion awarded from that name.
nextImplementation: Trace current combined-opportunity aircraft dispatch and target scoring completely before adding supported-element threat priority. Determine whether observations and aircraft support requests have a real missing execution path; do not add another global controller.
licence: UNVERIFIED; no upstream code copied into product.
validation: Workshop PBO hash matches registered intake; eight extracted file hashes recorded. Metadata-only review, no runtime edits or build rerun. Physical behaviour and performance UNRUN; audits PAUSED.
